answer_sentences.text: No. At the time of interest rate reset, the lender is not required to offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers the option to switch to a fixed rate; it is optional.
answer_sentences.quote: "a UCB may, at its option, provide a choice to the borrowers to switch over to a fixed rate as per its Board approved policy."

answer_sentences.text: The related rule also says borrowers must be given certain other choices, such as EMI enhancement, elongation of tenor, or prepayment, but it does not say the fixed-rate switch is mandatory.
answer_sentences.quote: "The borrowers shall also be given the choice to opt for (i) enhancement in EMI or elongation of tenor or for a combination of both options; and, (ii) to prepay, either in part or in full, at any point during the tenor of the loan."
